# `hk read`

- **How to hail it:** `hk read`
- **Effect:** read-only (looks, never touches)

Hand hk's Pkl modules to pkl as an external module reader

pkl hails this call to read `hk:` modules, so yer charts can `amends "hk:/Config.pkl"` and `import "hk:/Builtins.pkl"` and get the modules of the hk aboard instead of a pinned package, with no boat sent ashore. It speaks Pkl's external reader protocol on stdin and stdout and isn't meant to be hailed by hand. Enter it in a PklProject:

    evaluatorSettings {
      externalModuleReaders {
        ["hk"] { executable = "hk"; arguments { "read" } }
      }
    }

or hand `--external-module-reader hk='hk read'` to `pkl eval`.

## Flags to fly {#flags}

- **`-h --help`** — Print help, for when ye've lost yer bearings

## Tales from the deck {#examples}

Let pkl read `hk:` modules from the hk aboard this machine. pkl hails this call itself.

```sh
pkl eval --external-module-reader 'hk=hk read' hk.pkl
```
